name: n8n Workflow Heartbeat: silence, failure rate and inactive checks

parameters.content:
## Heartbeat
Every 5 minutes (or on a Check Now call) it reads the watch list from `WATCHLIST_JSON` and/or a Google Sheet, then asks the n8n API about each workflow: is it active, when did it last run successfully, how many of its recent runs failed. New problems are posted once, a problem that goes away gets one all clear. The open problems are saved only after Slack accepted the message.

## When the check itself fails
A bad watch list, an n8n API that still fails after its retries, or Slack refusing the alert ends the run at Stop: Heartbeat Failed, so your Error Workflow reports it. Nothing is alerted or cleared from half the facts.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Refused a heartbeat Check Now request: the Authorization: Bearer secret was missing or wrong.' + ($('Check Secret').first().json.secretSet ? '' : ' HEARTBEAT_SECRET is empty, so every request is refused.') }}
